senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; preced. wds.) bottom, foot; the frame in which an anvil is set.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 17:17">Kel. XVII, 17</cite> <he>ת׳ הצורפין</he> the base of the goldsmiths’ anvil; <he>של נפחין</he> of the blacksmiths’; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 7:10">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VII, 10</cite> <he>ת׳ צרפית</he>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:10">Num. R. s. 18<sup>4</sup></cite> <he>ונבלעו בשאול ת׳</he> and they were swallowed up in the nethermost of the nether world.
